title: Fasting vs. Eating Less: What's the Difference? (Science of Fasting)
summary: A short explainer on the physiological differences between fasting and simply eating less. It covers ketosis, ghrelin and hunger waves, and the hormonal effects of fasting.
why: Shared as an accessible, convincing case for intermittent fasting and its physiology.

quote.text: provide some compelling arguments for switching to intermittent fasting for many major systemic health benefits
